# Fast_Response_Actuation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The capability of an actuator to reach its target state in a very short time, enabling real-time or near-real-time feedback loops. Essential for synchronizing tactile feedback with high-speed data flows in TCC/iNEST systems, where latency directly impacts performance.
